title: Workers restarting every few minutes
root_cause_summary: Each job appended to a module-level cache that was never evicted, so worker RSS climbed until the container hit its limit and was OOM-killed.

required_evidence.why: the kill reason and exit code 137
memory climbing monotonically rather than spiking
the memoisation deploy four minutes before the climb starts

red_herrings.why_tempting: a change during the incident, but an operator mitigation rather than the cause
